opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until October 24, 2011, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
Justice Kagan took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
